metricDefinitions.acceptanceTieRule: rows sharing a confidence value are accepted or rejected together
metricDefinitions.aurcConvention: right-endpoint step integral of selective risk over coverage on [0, 1] using only achievable coverage points; increments sum to 1; no interpolation
metricDefinitions.brierFormulation: BS = mean_i sum_k (p_ik - y_ik)^2 over all 13 frozen classes; range [0, 2]; no factor of one half
metricDefinitions.eceEdgeRule: half-open [lo, hi) bins with the final bin closed at 1.0
metricDefinitions.fixedRiskReporting: maximum coverage at or below each risk target; unachievable targets are reported as unavailable, never omitted and never as zero coverage
metricDefinitions.matchedCoverageRule: nearest achievable empirical coverage without interpolation
metricDefinitions.matchedCoverageTieBreak: smaller absolute difference from the target first, then higher achieved coverage
metricDefinitions.nllFormulation: mean over rows of -log p[true class]; floor 1e-300
metricDefinitions.noveltyNote: novelty rates describe frozen deterministic support gates plus the frozen confidence threshold; they are not a statistical out-of-distribution detector
metricDefinitions.structuredExactMatch: exact 13-tuple class match; no partial credit
